question.prompt: The lengths of segments AB and CD are compared by superposition: point A is made to coincide with point C, and rays AB and CD point in the same direction. Point B then lies in the interior of segment CD (without coinciding with point D). What is the relationship between AB and CD?

solutions.explanation: Point B lies in the interior of segment CD, so AB is only part of CD. Therefore, \(AB<CD\).
solutions.title: Compare by superposition
